results.title: Kanhaiya Lal murder case: HC upholds UAPA charges against eight
results.description: Jaipur: The Rajasthan High Court has dismissed appeals filed by the eight accused in the Kanhaiya Lal murder case, upholding the charges framed against them by a special NIA court. results.title: Security Tightened Across J&K Ahead of Diwali
results.description: Kashmir, Observer, Jammu, Srinagar, Latest Kashmir News, Kashmir News, Kashmir Latest News Security has been tightened across Jammu and Kashmir ahead of Diwali, with the Special Operations Group (SOG) and other security forces maintaining heightened vigil at important locations, highways and sensitive points to ensure peaceful celebrations.
